material_result: For a literal orthogonal right rotation Q_t=Q_0R_t, the ambient projector is invariant. In the bounded control, an already aligned frozen subspace basis remained essentially exact (mean MSE 5.26e-11), whereas a random frozen basis was much worse (mean MSE 0.09918). Therefore a frozen-U comparison isolates tracking necessity only if U is first aligned before freezing or the implementation creates genuine ambient empirical-subspace motion; otherwise it can conflate initial subspace discovery with drift tracking.
